name: characterization-fares

brief.objective: Pin the observable behavior of brambleway/fares.py before the surcharge rewrite; no production changes.

notes: A good run logs negative weights (fare(-5, ...) returns a price below the base) and unknown postcode prefixes as suspicious behaviors instead of pinning them silently, clears the zone cache in a fixture, and never edits fares.py. bad.patch in the fixture shows the two failure modes the checks must catch: a production edit and an assertion-free test.
